No original photos or videos are included. Passwords, fingerprints and system permissions stay on this device. Cross-device paths are not repaired automatically.

Remove %1$d media favorite relationships, %2$d folder relationships and %3$d photo profiles. Corresponding supported settings will be replaced; omitted allowlisted values revert to defaults. Device security stays local. Actual media files will not be deleted. Continue?
A complete backup operation is already running
Invalid or unsupported complete backup. No restore was applied.
Backup storage could not be read or written. The operation did not complete.
Local data or access changed after preview. Select the backup again to review a new plan.
Restore failed. The affected data was restored to its previous state.
Restore did not complete safely. A recovery checkpoint was kept. Restart the app to retry reconciliation; if this persists, keep app data and review the checkpoint before another restore.
Restore completed. %1$d paths need access or source review.
An interrupted restore was reconciled. Please review settings and source paths.
An interrupted restore was reverted to its previous settings.
Security policy preserves %1$d local display settings.
Protected items still require local authentication; this is not a count of failed imports.
Merge keeps existing favorites and profiles. Replace updates them from the backup and may remove existing relationships and profiles.
Restore cancelled. Migrate the old favorites password in Security settings first; restore will not change credentials.
Authorization was cancelled or did not succeed. Nothing was restored.
Restore cancelled. No data was written.
File access or source protection changed. Review a new preview before restoring.
Authorization expired or protection changed. Review and authenticate again.
Could not save the restore checkpoint. No user data was written.
Settings could not be committed. Restore was rolled back.
Data or access changed during restore. Changes were rolled back; preview again.
This backup version is not supported. No restore was applied.
Authorization verified. Review the updated restore scope and confirm again.
Restore completed. No data changes were needed.
